package.description: Transform your photos by repairing, enlarging, face-swapping, compressing and colorizing, all without losing quality. Perfect for enhancing your images easily.

en-US.description: Transform your photos by repairing, enlarging, face-swapping, compressing and colorizing, all without losing quality. Perfect for enhancing your images easily.
en-US.longDescription:
Wise ImageX provides a range of powerful AI-powered image enhancement and optimization tools. With these impressive features, you can easily restore damaged photos, colorize black-and-white pictures, enlarge pictures and improve clarity, reduce image file size without quality loss, and face swapping.

- Photo Restoration
- Picture Colorization
- Face Swap
- Super Resolution
- Smart Eraser
- Image Compression
en-US.name: Wise ImageX
